# Scratch & Roam with Natali

> First-timer China travel guides and videos from Natali, a maker based in Ireland. Every guide is written from first-hand experience, dated and rechecked, and pairs a YouTube video with step by step answers.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://scratchandroam.com/): newest videos and the questions first-time visitors ask
- [China guides](https://scratchandroam.com/china/): every guide, grouped by before you fly, at the border, and once you are there
- [About](https://scratchandroam.com/about/): who Natali is and how the guides are made

## Guides

- [Alipay metro QR code in China: how to add it](https://scratchandroam.com/guides/alipay-metro-qr-code-china/): How to add the Alipay metro and bus QR code for China: pick the city, claim the free card, enter your payment password, and fix the wrong-city code.
- [Build Spice Tolerance Before China: 6 Week Plan](https://scratchandroam.com/guides/build-spice-tolerance-before-china/): How to build spice tolerance before China: why mala burns and numbs, a 6 week plan, what actually cools the heat, and how to order mild in Chinese.
- [China arrival card in Alipay: step by step guide](https://scratchandroam.com/guides/china-arrival-card-alipay/): The China arrival card in Alipay on your phone, step by step. Upload your passport and most of the form fills in for you.
- [China arrival card on a PC: step by step guide](https://scratchandroam.com/guides/china-arrival-card-pc/): The China arrival card online on a computer, step by step, with the real form enlarged. Upload your passport and most of it fills in for you.
- [China do's and don'ts: 15 rules before you fly (2026)](https://scratchandroam.com/guides/china-dos-and-donts/): China do's and don'ts for first-timers: what customs and security take off you, table manners that get stares, and what to pack or buy there.
- [China first trip checklist: safety and backups (2026)](https://scratchandroam.com/guides/china-before-you-fly-checklist/): The safety and backup side of a first China trip: insurance, your hotel in Chinese, emergency numbers, data, payments, copies, scams and a medical kit.
- [China travel apps: 12 to set up before you go (2026)](https://scratchandroam.com/guides/china-travel-apps/): The China travel apps to set up before you fly: paying, maps, taxis and trains, what to do at home, the extras inside Alipay, and what to skip.
- [China Visa Free 30 Days: Irish, UK and EU Passports](https://scratchandroam.com/guides/china-visa-free-30-days/): Who gets 30 days visa free in China, until when, what to show at the border, and whether you can extend or leave and come back.
- [First time in China: 13 things to set up before you fly](https://scratchandroam.com/guides/first-time-in-china/): First time in China? The 13 things we set up before flying: entry rules, the arrival card, Alipay and WeChat, cash, flights, trains, maps and packing.
- [How to Order Food in China Without Speaking Chinese](https://scratchandroam.com/guides/how-to-order-food-in-china-without-speaking-chinese/): How to order food in China without speaking Chinese: phrases to point at, scan-to-order menus, night market and street stall ordering, and how to pay.
- [How to order on Taobao as a foreigner: step by step guide](https://scratchandroam.com/guides/taobao-for-foreigners/): How to order on Taobao without speaking Chinese: language and currency settings, searching in English, hotel delivery and paying with Alipay.
- [Huangpu River night cruise Shanghai: pier, ticket, time](https://scratchandroam.com/guides/huangpu-river-night-cruise/): Huangpu River night cruise: three piers, about 120 to 150 RMB, how to book as a foreigner, why your passport matters, and which side to stand on.
- [Nanjing Road Shanghai: metro exit, neon times and the walk](https://scratchandroam.com/guides/nanjing-road-shanghai/): Nanjing Road: 1.6 km from People's Square to the Bund, the metro exits at each end, when the neon is on, and the walk that ends at the river.
- [Shanghai Circus World ERA show: tickets and how to get there](https://scratchandroam.com/guides/shanghai-circus-world-era-show/): ERA at Shanghai Circus World: metro Line 1, exit 3, shows at 19:30 Tuesday to Sunday, ticket zones and prices, and where foreigners can book.
- [Taobao 11.11 for foreigners: Singles' Day 2026 guide](https://scratchandroam.com/guides/taobao-11-11-singles-day-for-foreigners/): How the 2026 11.11 sale works on Taobao and Tmall: dates, paying with Alipay and a foreign card, presale deposits, hotel delivery and what to check first.
- [The Bund Shanghai at night: how to get there and when to go](https://scratchandroam.com/guides/the-bund-shanghai-at-night/): How to get to the Bund by metro (East Nanjing Road, exit 2 or 7), the best time for the lights, when they switch off, and a simple river route.
- [Top 25 China apps for tourists, ranked (2026)](https://scratchandroam.com/guides/top-25-china-apps/): The 25 apps worth having for a trip to China, ranked from critical to optional: what each does, how to set it up, and what you lose without it.
